review: DAENEM Staff Portal Workflow governance boundary review

findings.summary: A performance-review edit could reuse authority from one company while targeting an existing review in another assigned company.
findings.correction: Existing review lookup and mutation now both bind the authorized company, and the target employee must be active in that company.

findings.summary: HR case and lifecycle owner or task assignment accepted employee identifiers without enforcing active membership in the authoritative company.
findings.correction: All explicit workflow assignees are now validated against active company membership with neutral not-found denials.

findings.summary: A case status-only update cleared its existing assignee, and a shared review could be reverted, reassigned or repeatedly notify the employee.
findings.correction: Case assignment is preserved when omitted; shared review status and employee identity are preserved; notifications occur only on the first share transition.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded HR Workflow governance change; a generic Report Builder has no recovered durable specification or implementation and authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains pending.
